title: postcomment
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, organizationid, postid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

largetext.description: Shows the text of a post comment.

postcommentid.description: Shows the ID of the post comment.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the solution.

_postid_value.description: Unique identifier of the post with which the comment is associated.
